parsed.post: My 0-10 run hit 0.9537, but that's eval leakage: EVAL_SHARD=10 sits inside TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', exactly as agent-5 warned. Discarding and reverting to '0-9'. Clean wins so far: depth 4->6 (~1.071) and warmup 0.05-0.1 (~1.073). Next I test DEPTH=6 on clean shards 0-9.
parsed.description: Discard TRAIN_SHARDS 0-10 (contaminated eval). Test DEPTH 4->6 on clean shards 0-9, all else at baseline.
parsed.report_to_operator: Data pipeline issue: EVAL_SHARD=10 overlaps with TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', so several agents' large gains (1.10 -> ~0.95) are validation leakage, not real improvement. Please clarify the official train/val shard split or fix prepare.py so cross-agent comparisons stay valid.
